title: Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries

entities.name: Cordelia
entities.description: A Stromkirk vampire of a few hundred years who attends Olivia's wedding and nearly falls afoul of Henrika Domnathi.

entities.name: Relio
entities.description: A Voldaren vampire who prattles about Olivia and is killed by Henrika Domnathi.

entities.name: Henrika Domnathi
entities.description: A vampire noble, rumored one-time lover of Griselbrand, who kills Relio at the wedding and loves revenge more than power.

entities.name: Kristoff Laurent
entities.description: A Markov duelist killed by a Nusfar child at the wedding.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: A vampire lady who stages a wedding to Edgar Markov and presents herself as the new lord of Innistrad.

entities.name: Edgar Markov
entities.description: Sorin's ancient vampire grandfather, awakened in the coffin by Olivia's blood and apparently enthralled.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker who enters the wedding alone, tries to stop the ritual and is restrained by guards.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer who waits outside the estate with the group and wants to burn the gates.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who stops Chandra at the guarded barrier and defends her.

entities.name: Adeline
entities.description: A cathar who comforts Chandra and waits outside with the allies.

entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: A planeswalker and werewolf who proposed bringing Sorin as a wedding guest.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who offers to follow Sorin into the wedding as a ghost.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: A demon of whom Henrika is the rumored one-time lover.

entities.name: Runo Stromkirk
entities.description: A vampire noble who would sooner give himself to the beings of the sea than marry Olivia.

entities.name: Voldaren family
entities.description: Olivia's vampire house, hosts of the wedding.

entities.name: Markov family
entities.description: Sorin's vampire family, whose coffins Olivia opens to wake relatives for the groom's side.

entities.name: Domnathi
entities.description: A vampire bloodline famous for consorting with demons.

entities.name: Nusfar
entities.description: Vampires who look like children but are fierce predators.

entities.name: Stromkirk
entities.description: A vampire bloodline with prophetic sermons.

entities.name: Falkenrath
entities.description: A vampire bloodline that has earned a new name for itself.

entities.name: Voldaren Estate
entities.description: Olivia's castle, with floating towers, red petals and blood fountains, where the wedding takes place.

entities.name: Markov manor
entities.description: Sorin's home, where his family coffins were stored.

entities.name: Muttering Corridors
entities.description: The confusing halls of the Voldaren Estate filled with geists.

entities.name: Moonsilver Key
entities.description: The key the allies hope to retrieve.

entities.name: Harvesttide Massacre
entities.description: The attack on the festival that Chandra remembers.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane the vampires are vying to rule.

events.summary: Cordelia and Relio attend Olivia Voldaren's wedding at the Voldaren Estate, where Nusfar duels end in killings.
events.quote: a boy who looks all of ten drives his hand into a man's chest

events.summary: Henrika Domnathi kills Relio with blood magic and menaces Cordelia.
events.quote: Relio's next nonsense dies the moment he does

events.summary: Olivia Voldaren makes a grand entrance, announces the wedding and has thralls carry in a coffin for the groom.
events.quote: an elaborate stone coffin: marble inlaid with gold, crowned by Markovian rays

events.summary: The Gatewatch and allies reach the gates of the Voldaren Estate, but the guards admit only one person per invitation.
events.quote: "One person per invitation," the guards intone together.

events.summary: Chandra remembers the Harvesttide Massacre and agrees they cannot fight without the key; Sorin agrees to enter alone.
events.quote: "I've been alone for centuries," he says. "This will be no different."

events.summary: Sorin walks through the estate escorted by guards and reflects that Olivia chose a political marriage with his grandfather.
events.quote: It was only natural that someone so nakedly ambitious would hit on the idea of a political marriage.

events.summary: Sorin is announced in the ballroom and sees his grandfather's coffin on the dais.
events.quote: There's no mistaking it: that is his grandfather's coffin.

events.summary: Olivia cuts her arm to let her blood drip into Edgar's coffin to wake him.
events.quote: Old blood, potent blood, blood dark as the night around them, drips onto Edgar Markov's coffin.

events.summary: Sorin charges at Olivia, killing one guard and freezing two, but is bound with Blessed Silver chains by the guards.
events.quote: When Sorin pounces on one, he tears out their throat before the two of them even hit the ground.

events.summary: Edgar Markov wakes, drinks Olivia's blood and is presented as her betrothed; he dismisses Sorin's warnings.
events.quote: "I present to you my handsome, perfect betrothed: Lord Edgar Markov."

events.summary: Olivia wakes other Markov ancients for the groom's side, and Sorin's family passes him by without a word.
events.quote: A few drops is all it takes to start the process of waking the ancients.

relations.quote: His grandfather —his grandfather, who created everything these people so value!

relations.note: She marries him in a political match.
relations.quote: I present to you my handsome, perfect betrothed: Lord Edgar Markov.

relations.note: She kills him at the wedding.
relations.quote: Henrika Domnathi, noted demon sympathizer, stands just behind him.
"Relio, you're a Voldaren," she says flatly.
The Domnathi bloodline is famous for consorting with demons
The victim is Kristoff Laurent, a Markov known for dueling at the drop of a hat
The rumored one-time lover of Griselbrand smirks.

relations.note: He tries to stop her wedding ritual.
